description: This file defines a function that creates a sandbox policy for the 'wmediumd_gen_config' tool within the 'cuttlefish::process_sandboxer' namespace. It includes policy building and path utilities, and references external sandboxing and path libraries.

methods.name: WmediumdGenConfigPolicy
methods.description: Creates and returns a sandbox2::PolicyBuilder configured for the 'wmediumd_gen_config' tool, adding a writable directory based on the host's environment.
